scenarios.name: Standard CRUD Task Manager
scenarios.client_text: Build a task management application. Users can create tasks, list all tasks, update task status, and delete tasks.

scenarios.name: E-Commerce Shopping Cart
scenarios.client_text: Create an online bookstore where customers can search books, add them to a cart, view cart totals, and place an order.

scenarios.name: Clinic Appointment Booking
scenarios.client_text: Build a doctor appointment scheduling tool. Patients select a specialist doctor, pick an available calendar time slot, and submit booking.

scenarios.name: Sales Lead CRM Pipeline
scenarios.client_text: We need a simple CRM to record sales leads with contact info, move leads across pipeline stages (New, Qualified, Won, Lost), and log follow-up notes.

scenarios.name: Personal Habit Tracker Mobile App
scenarios.client_text: Mobile application for daily habit tracking. Users create habits, check them off daily, view current streak count, and set a reminder time.

scenarios.client_text: All user data must be purely client-side with zero database storage. Also provide cross-device sync across all mobile and web devices.
